description: SECURITY (s441 fix round 3, review N1). A scheduler name bound by a destructuring pattern inside an inline event handler is an ordinary function, not the global scheduler, so passing an async-colored function to it is not fire-and-forget: it calls it and returns the unawaited Promise — always truthy (reviewer-executed with real scrml:auth hashing: a wrong password accepted). Round 2 recognised only simple declarations; the exemption now holds only when every occurrence of the name in the source is a plain call or a member read.
rationale: §13.2: the fire-and-forget exemption applies only to the global scheduler; a program-bound name of any binding form is an ordinary function, and passing an async-colored function to it SHALL be E-ASYNC-FN-ESCAPES-AS-VALUE (§34).
